name: lipid A to H
summary: A 7-step route from lipid A(4−) to H(+), ingested from Rhea. Every step is curated by Rhea and independently verified here to balance in mass and charge.

reactions.name: lipid A + 4-amino-4-deoxy-alpha-L-arabinopyranosyl di-trans,octa-cis-undecaprenyl phosp...
reactions.equation: lipid A + 4-amino-4-deoxy-alpha-L-arabinopyranosyl di-trans,octa-cis-undecaprenyl phosphate = 4-amino-4-deoxy-beta-L-arabinopyranosyl-lipid A + di-trans,octa-cis-undecaprenyl phosphate

reactions.name: N-acetylglucosaminyldiphosphoundecaprenol N-acetyl-beta-D-
reactions.equation: UDP-N-acetyl-alpha-D-mannosamine + N-acetyl-alpha-D-glucosaminyl-di-trans,octa-cis-undecaprenyl diphosphate = N-acetyl-beta-D-mannosaminyl-(1->4)-N-acetyl-alpha-D-glucosaminyl di-trans,octa-cis-undecaprenyl diphosphate + UDP + H(+)

reactions.name: teichoic acid glycerol-phosphate primase
reactions.equation: N-acetyl-beta-D-mannosaminyl-(1->4)-N-acetyl-alpha-D-glucosaminyl di-trans,octa-cis-undecaprenyl diphosphate + CDP-glycerol = 4-O-[(2R)-glycerylphospho]-N-acetyl-beta-D-mannosaminyl-(1->4)-N-acetyl-alpha-D-glucosaminyl di-trans,octa-cis-undecaprenyl diphosphate + CMP + H(+)

reactions.name: teichoic acid glycerol-phosphate transferase
reactions.equation: 4-O-[(2R)-glycerylphospho]-N-acetyl-beta-D-mannosaminyl-(1->4)-N-acetyl-alpha-D-glucosaminyl di-trans,octa-cis-undecaprenyl diphosphate + CDP-glycerol = 4-O-[di(2R)-glycerylphospho]-N-acetyl-beta-D-mannosaminyl-(1->4)-N-acetyl-alpha-D-glucosaminyl di-trans,octa-cis-undecaprenyl diphosphate + CMP + H(+)

reactions.name: a ganglioside GM3 + CMP-N-acetyl-9-O-acetyl-beta-neuraminate = a ganglioside Ac-O-9-GD3...
reactions.equation: a ganglioside GM3 + CMP-N-acetyl-9-O-acetyl-beta-neuraminate = a ganglioside Ac-O-9-GD3 + CMP + H(+)

reactions.name: a ganglioside GD3 (d18:1(4E)) + CMP-N-acetyl-9-O-acetyl-beta-neuraminate = a gangliosid...
reactions.equation: a ganglioside GD3 (d18:1(4E)) + CMP-N-acetyl-9-O-acetyl-beta-neuraminate = a ganglioside Ac-O-9-GT3 (d18:1(4E)) + CMP + H(+)

reactions.name: CMP-N-acetyl-9-O-acetyl-beta-neuraminate + a ganglioside GM1 (d18:1(4E)) = a gangliosid...
reactions.equation: CMP-N-acetyl-9-O-acetyl-beta-neuraminate + a ganglioside GM1 (d18:1(4E)) = a ganglioside Ac-O-9-GD1a (d18:1(4E)) + CMP + H(+)
